_comment: Shared talent-cover header (Nov 2026, neutral palette). All positions are fractions of the image WIDTH, so the header has identical proportions on every cover and at every screen size. Logo = the site's master logo export (public/images/site/logo_payoff.svg, ink #141112); names use the same ink, one font, weight and size (fitted once to the longest name), centred between the divider and the right edge.
